caption: The drawing depicts two distinct objects placed against a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a padded, oval-shaped object in shades of red with darker and lighter areas to indicate contours and texture, and it includes a small, rectangular buckle and strap detail, suggesting a fastening mechanism. On the right side, there is a brown, cylindrical container with a flared top and a slightly convex lid that is partially open, revealing a reddish interior. The container has visible stitching along the seams and a brass-colored circular lock plate on its front side, along with attached leather straps and buckles. Both objects are rendered with attention to texture, using variations in their respective hues to indicate folds and shadows.
title: Man's Hat Box
